scope: All six utilities.py contracts in TASKS.md; no implementation authorized by this review
evidence: Independently read TASKS.md, PLAN.md and utilities.py only within the full_team pilot folder.
The six seeded functions have local defects that can be repaired without public signature changes or third-party dependencies.
PLAN.md preserves one implementation owner, requires the parent-recorded consensus gate before implementation, and schedules independent checks against the final snapshot.

findings.evidence: The existing shallow copy aliases nested containers; TASKS.md requires bidirectional input/result independence.
findings.recommendation: Use standard-library deepcopy for retained and replacement branches as well as recursively merged dictionaries; check mutation of either input after merge.

findings.evidence: Prerequisites may be generators and duplicated; CSV blank physical rows differ from an explicitly quoted empty cell.
findings.recommendation: Materialize each prerequisite iterable once and deduplicate edges; use a ready-node min-heap. Parse CSV records with csv.reader, skip only empty row lists, and validate normalized headers and row widths.

findings.evidence: The cache currently shares class-level state and accepts the expiration boundary; transfers mutate input directly and do not validate amounts.
findings.recommendation: Create instance-local cache storage and reject invalid ttl before mutation. Apply transfers to a private dictionary, explicitly exclude bool amounts, and validate sufficient funds before handling self-transfers.

checks_executed: Read-only source and contract feasibility inspection; no behavioral tests or implementation performed.
graph_note: No project indexing or broad source searches performed: the assigned review is restricted to three named synthetic target files and permits only this review artifact to be written.
